about.title: About
about.heroBody: A free Makruk (Thai chess) web app with no ads and no sign-up. Play the computer, play friends online or pass-and-play on one device, and learn the rules from scratch.
about.makrukBody: Makruk is a close cousin of international chess, played on an 8×8 board with the Khun, Met, Khon, Ma, Ruea and Bia. The Bia start on the third rank and promote to a Met on the sixth. When few pieces are left, counting rules give the stronger side a limited number of moves to deliver checkmate.
about.projectBody: All the code is on GitHub under the GPL-3.0 license. Anyone can help — report bugs, improve lessons, review translations or write code.

home.aboutTitle: Play Thai chess online for free
home.aboutBody1: Makruk, or Thai chess (หมากรุกไทย), is the traditional chess of Thailand. Play Makruk online here for free with no sign-up: challenge the computer at six levels, invite a friend to an online game with a link, or pass-and-play on one device.
home.aboutBody2: New to the game? Interactive Thai chess lessons teach how the Khun, Met, Khon, Ma, Ruea and Bia move, checkmate and the counting rules. Works on phones and computers, and installs as an app for offline play.

coach.title: Coach Khun
coach.waiting: Waiting for your opponent… think about your next move.
coach.firstMove: Start by pushing a centre Bia forward, like the d- or e-Bia.
coach.inCheck: Your Khun is in check! Escape, block, or capture the attacker.
coach.lostPiece: Your opponent captured a piece. Check which of your pieces are unprotected.
coach.promote: You can promote a Bia! Move it to the sixth row to turn it into a Met.
coach.capture: You can capture one of your opponent's pieces right now — look for it.
coach.develop: Bring your Ma and Khon out to join the game.
coach.safeKhun: Keep your Khun safe early in the game.
coach.useHint: Not sure? Tap the Hint button.
coach.gameOver: Game over — well played! Start a new game or try the next lesson.
